questions.question: All TfL PHV driver applicants must hold a current:
questions.explanation: An Enhanced DBS check is required for taxi and PHV drivers.

questions.question: If a serious offence appears during your licence period, TfL may:
questions.explanation: TfL acts to protect public safety, including suspension or revocation.

questions.question: Subscribing to the DBS Update Service helps drivers by:
options: Keeping the certificate continuously up to date
questions.explanation: The Update Service allows certificates to be re-checked online.

questions.question: PHV drivers must also pass a:
options: Medical assessment to DVLA Group 2 standard
questions.explanation: Drivers must meet the Group 2 medical standard.

questions.question: If your enhanced DBS lapses, you must:
options: Stop working until renewed and notify TfL
questions.explanation: Driving without a valid licence and checks is unlawful.

questions.question: Convictions that may bar a licence include:
questions.explanation: Serious offences are weighed under TfL's policy and statutory guidance.

questions.question: Spent convictions in licensing decisions are:
options: Disclosable on enhanced checks where relevant
questions.explanation: Some spent convictions can still be disclosed for taxi/PHV roles.
